$ kubectl scale deploy nginx --replicas=3
--- exit 0
--- stdout
deployment.apps/nginx scaled
--- stderr

$ kubectl get deploy nginx
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME    READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
nginx   3/3     3            3           60m
--- stderr

$ kubectl get rs
--- exit 0

nginx-4fzxcz7snh   3         3         3       60m
--- stderr

$ kubectl events --for deployment/nginx

$ kubectl scale deployment/nginx --replicas=1 --current-replicas=2

$ kubectl scale deploy nginx --replicas=51
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
The Deployment "nginx" is invalid: spec.replicas: Invalid value: 51: KubeDojo allows 0 to 50 replicas

$ kubectl scale deploy nginx --replicas=-1
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: The --replicas=COUNT flag is required, and COUNT must be greater than or equal to 0

$ kubectl scale deploy nginx
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout

error: required flag(s) "replicas" not set

$ kubectl scale svc web --replicas=2
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: no scaler has been implemented for services: the simulator scales deployments and replicasets

$ kubectl scale deploy nope --replicas=2
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (NotFound): deployments.apps "nope" not found

$ kubectl scale deploy --all -n shop --replicas=0
--- exit 0
--- stdout
deployment.apps/orders scaled
--- stderr

$ kubectl get deploy -n shop

orders   0/0     0            0           10m
